```r

nrow(data_full)
data_full %>%
  group_by(impact)%>%
  summarise(
    n=n(),
    total = 1600,
    incarc = sum(incarc, na.rm = TRUE),
    incarc_pct = ((incarc / total) *100),
    knowincarc = sum(knowincarc, na.rm = TRUE),
    knowincarc_pct = ((knowincarc / total) *100),
    vict = sum(vict, na.rm = TRUE),
    vict_pct = ((vict / total) *100),
    any_impact = sum(impact, na.rm = TRUE),
    any_impact_pct = ((any_impact / total) *100)
  )
```

  group_by(incarc) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    incarc_total = sum(incarc, na.rm = TRUE),
    White = sum(White, na.rm = TRUE), 
    pct_white = ((White / incarc_total) *100),
    Black = sum(Black, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_black = ((Black / incarc_total) *100),
    Hisp_Latino       = sum(Hisp_Latino, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_hi = ((Hisp_Latino / incarc_total) *100),
    Asian_Am     = sum(Asian_Am, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_aa = ((Asian_Am / incarc_total) *100),
    Native_am = sum(Native_Am, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_nat = ((Native_am / incarc_total) *100),
    OtherRace = sum(OtherRace, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_other = ((OtherRace / incarc_total) *100)
  )

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

#----------------------------
# 1. Reshape race indicators long
#----------------------------
race_impact_long <- data_full %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(race_vars), all_of(impact_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(race_vars),
    names_to = \race_var\,
    values_to = \in_race\
  ) %>%
  filter(in_race == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    race = recode(race_var, !!!race_labels)
  )

#----------------------------
# 2. Plot ANY impact by race
#----------------------------
impact_by_race <- race_impact_long %>%
  group_by(race) %>%
  summarise(
    pct_impacted = mean(impact, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_race = n(),
    .groups = \drop\
  )

ggplot(impact_by_race, aes(x = fct_reorder(race, pct_impacted), y = pct_impacted)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = \Share with any impact\,
    title = \Proportion of each racial group with any carceral contact\
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal()

impact_by_race_type <- race_impact_long %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(impact_vars),
    names_to = \impact_var\,
    values_to = \has_impact\
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    impact_type = recode(impact_var, !!!impact_labels)
  ) %>%
  group_by(race, impact_type) %>%
  summarise(
    pct = mean(has_impact, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = \drop\
  )

ggplot(impact_by_race_type, aes(x = race, y = pct, fill = impact_type)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = \Share within racial group\,
    fill = NULL,
    title = \Sample Carceral Contact by Race\
  ) +

```r
impact_by_race_type <- race_impact_long %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(impact_vars),
    names_to = \impact_var\,
    values_to = \has_impact\
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    impact_type = recode(impact_var, !!!impact_labels)
  ) %>%
  group_by(race, impact_type) %>%
  summarise(
    pct = mean(has_impact, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = \drop\
  )

ggplot(impact_by_race_type, aes(x = race, y = pct, fill = impact_type)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = \Share within racial group\,
    fill = NULL,
    title = \Sample Carceral Contact by Race\
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)

# race vars and labels
race_vars <- c(\White\, \Black\, \Hisp_Latino\, \OtherRace\)

race_labels <- c(
  White = \White\,
  Black = \Black\,
  Hisp_Latino = \Hisp_Latino\,
  OtherRace = \Other Race\
)

impact_vars <- c(\impact\, \incarc\, \knowincarc\, \vict\)

impact_labels <- c(
  impact = \Any Impact\,
  incarc = \Direct\,
  knowincarc = \Proximal\,
  vict = \Victim\
)

# function: one table for one racial group
make_race_impact_table <- function(race_var) {
  
  dat_race <- data_full %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[race_var]] == 1)
  
  race_n <- nrow(dat_race)
  
  tibble(
    Impact = unname(impact_labels),
    n = purrr::map_int(impact_vars, ~ sum(dat_race[[.x]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      pct = round(100 * n / race_n, 1),
      `n (%)` = sprintf(\%d (%.1f\\%%)\, n, pct)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(Impact, `n (%)`)
}

# create all four tables as a named list
race_impact_tables <- setNames(
  lapply(race_vars, make_race_impact_table),
  unname(race_labels)
)

# view one example
race_impact_tables[[\White\]]

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)

# race vars and labels
race_vars <- c(\White\, \Black\, \Hisp_Latino\, \OtherRace\)

race_labels <- c(
  White = \White\,
  Black = \Black\,
  Hisp_Latino = \Hisp_Latino\,
  OtherRace = \Other Race\
)

impact_vars <- c(\impact\, \incarc\, \knowincarc\, \vict\)

impact_labels <- c(
  impact = \Any Impact\,
  incarc = \Direct\,
  knowincarc = \Proximal\,
  vict = \Victim\
)

# function: one table for one racial group
make_race_impact_table <- function(race_var) {
  
  dat_race <- data_full %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[race_var]] == 1)
  
  race_n <- nrow(dat_race)
  
  tibble(
    Impact = unname(impact_labels),
    n = purrr::map_int(impact_vars, ~ sum(dat_race[[.x]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      pct = round(100 * n / race_n, 1),
      `n (%)` = sprintf(\%d (%.1f\\%%)\, n, pct)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(Impact, `n (%)`)
}

# create all four tables as a named list
race_impact_tables <- setNames(
  lapply(race_vars, make_race_impact_table),
  unname(race_labels)
)

# view one example
race_impact_tables[[\White\]]

```r

race_experience_plot <- race_experience_plot %>%
  mutate(
    Race = factor(
      Race,
      levels = c(
        \Black\,
        \Hispanic/Latino\,
        \Native American\,
        \Other Race\,
        \Asian American\,
        \White\
      )
    ),
    Experience = factor(
      Experience,
      levels = c(
        \Incarcerated\,
        \Victimized\,
        \Know Incarcerated\,
        \Any Impact\
      )
    )
  )


print(n = 25,
race_experience_plot %>%
  dplyr::select(Race, Experience, denominator)
)
```

race_experience_figure <- ggplot(
  race_experience_plot,
  aes(
    x = Race,
    y = proportion
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  
  # Four panels, arranged 2 x 2
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Experience,
    ncol = 2,
    scales = \free_y\
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = \Proportion of Group Reporting Yes\
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = \bold\,
      size = 11
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 30,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

race_experience_figure

```r
```r

race_experience_figure <- ggplot(
  race_experience_plot,
  aes(
    x = Race,
    y = proportion
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  
  # Four panels, arranged 2 x 2
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Experience,
    ncol = 2,
    scales = \free_y\
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = \Proportion of Group Reporting Yes\
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = \bold\,
      size = 11
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 30,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

race_experience_figure

```

economic_vars <- c(
  \snap\,
  \tanf\,
  \medicaid\,
  \unemployed\,
  \uninsured\
)

economic_impact_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(
  economic_vars,
  function(var) {

    data_full %>%
      filter(.data[[var]] == 1) %>%
      summarise(
        variable = var,
        n_group = n(),

        incarc_n = sum(incarc == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        incarc_prop = mean(incarc == 1, na.rm = TRUE),

        knowincarc_n = sum(knowincarc == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        knowincarc_prop = mean(knowincarc == 1, na.rm = TRUE),

        vict_n = sum(vict == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        vict_prop = mean(vict == 1, na.rm = TRUE),

        impact_n = sum(impact == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        impact_prop = mean(impact == 1, na.rm = TRUE),

        no_impact_n = sum(impact == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
        no_impact_prop = mean(impact == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
  }
)

economic_impact_summary



economic_impact_plot <- economic_impact_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(
    variable,
    incarc_prop,
    knowincarc_prop,
    vict_prop,
    impact_prop,
    no_impact_prop
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -variable,
    names_to = \impact_type\,
    values_to = \proportion\
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    impact_type = recode(
      impact_type,
      incarc_prop = \Direct\,
      knowincarc_prop = \Proximal\,
      vict_prop = \Victim\,
      impact_prop = \Any Impact\,
      no_impact_prop = \No Impact\
    ),
    impact_type = factor(
      impact_type,
      levels = c(
        \Direct\,
        \Proximal\,
        \Victim\,
        \Any Impact\,
        \No Impact\
      )
    )
  )

print(n = 25, economic_impact_plot)

```r
```r
economic_vars <- c(
  \snap\,
  \tanf\,
  \medicaid\,
  \unemployed\,
  \uninsured\
)

economic_impact_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(
  economic_vars,
  function(var) {

    data_full %>%
      filter(.data[[var]] == 1) %>%
      summarise(
        variable = var,
        n_group = n(),

        incarc_n = sum(incarc == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        incarc_prop = mean(incarc == 1, na.rm = TRUE),

        knowincarc_n = sum(knowincarc == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        knowincarc_prop = mean(knowincarc == 1, na.rm = TRUE),

        vict_n = sum(vict == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        vict_prop = mean(vict == 1, na.rm = TRUE),

        impact_n = sum(impact == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        impact_prop = mean(impact == 1, na.rm = TRUE),

        no_impact_n = sum(impact == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
        no_impact_prop = mean(impact == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
  }
)

economic_impact_summary



economic_impact_plot <- economic_impact_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(
    variable,
    incarc_prop,
    knowincarc_prop,
    vict_prop,
    impact_prop,
    no_impact_prop
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -variable,
    names_to = \impact_type\,
    values_to = \proportion\
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    impact_type = recode(
      impact_type,
      incarc_prop = \Direct\,
      knowincarc_prop = \Proximal\,
      vict_prop = \Victim\,
      impact_prop = \Any Impact\,
      no_impact_prop = \No Impact\
    ),
    impact_type = factor(
      impact_type,
      levels = c(
        \Direct\,
        \Proximal\,
        \Victim\,
        \Any Impact\,
        \No Impact\
      )
    )
  )

print(n = 25, economic_impact_plot)
```

make_economic_plot <- function(var_name, plot_title) {
  
  economic_impact_plot %>%
    filter(variable == var_name) %>%
    ggplot(
      aes(
        x = impact_type,
        y = proportion
      )
    ) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = scales::percent(proportion, accuracy = 0.1)),
      vjust = -0.4
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::percent,
      limits = c(0, 0.75)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = NULL,
      y = \Proportion of Group Reporting Yes\
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 30,
        hjust = 1
      )
    )
}

plot_snap <- make_economic_plot(
  \snap\,
  \SNAP Recipients\
)

plot_tanf <- make_economic_plot(
  \tanf\,
  \TANF Recipients\
)

plot_medicaid <- make_economic_plot(
  \medicaid\,
  \Medicaid Recipients\
)

plot_unemployed <- make_economic_plot(
  \unemployed\,
  \Unemployed Respondents\
)

plot_uninsured <- make_economic_plot(
  \uninsured\,
  \Uninsured Respondents\
)
